page_title: BRE 3-2 NOT | Brentford v Nottingham Forest 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' Brandon Aguilera Zamora (Nottingham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+7' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) will replace Mathias Jensen.
90+6' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90+5' 11:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
90' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Kristoffer Ajer.
90' Here is a change. Keane Lewis-Potter is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Josh Dasilva (Brentford).
88' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) picks up an injury.
86' It is time for a substitution. Brandon Aguilera Zamora (Nottingham) is on for Gonzalo Montiel.
85' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
84' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Matt Turner is alert and makes a decent save.

80' Close! Orel Mangala (Nottingham) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
78' The foul by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
76' Neco Williams (Nottingham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
74' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) replacing Neal Maupay.
74' A substitution has been made. Mikkel Damsgaard is replaced by Shandon Baptiste (Brentford).
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
72' Neco Williams (Nottingham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
70' Referee Darren England points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Neal Maupay (Brentford) goes wild in celebration.
69' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Brentford goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
68' 3 - 2 Goal! Mads Roerslev Rasmussen sends a precise cross into the box, Neal Maupay (Brentford) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:2.
66' Darren England shows a yellow card to Ivan Toney (Brentford) for his blatant foul.
65' 2 - 2 Goal! Callum Hudson-Odoi swings the ball deep into the box and finds Chris Wood (Nottingham) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom right corner. 2:2.
63' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
62' Ryan Yates will be replaced by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
61' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

59' 2 - 1 Mathias Jensen sends over a killer cross from the resulting corner and expertly finds Ben Mee (Brentford), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the top left corner. It's 2:1.
58' Corner kick. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is ready to send the ball into the box.

57' What a big chance! Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
55' Chance! Orel Mangala (Nottingham) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
54' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

54' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Matt Turner is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Danilo (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Some patient build-up play from Nottingham as they look to unlock the defence.
47' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Darren England blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+2' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Ivan Toney (Brentford) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.

43' Neal Maupay (Brentford) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now. Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
41' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
41' Neal Maupay (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) causes Mark Flekken little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
36' Wonderful pass from Orel Mangala (Nottingham) for Nicolas Dominguez, but they can't profit from it as Mark Flekken comes off his line to collect.
35' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
31' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fires a rebound from close range onto the bar!
31' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
30' The corner from Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is hurriedly cleared. Brentford get a corner.
28' An attempted cross from Orel Mangala (Nottingham) is cleared.
28' Neal Maupay (Brentford) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
27' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
25' Brentford take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
22' Nottingham couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Mark Flekken (Brentford) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
19' 1 - 1 Ivan Toney (Brentford) fires a daisy-cutter inside the right post from the free kick just outside the box. Football supporters are always happy to see such a fabulous goal.
18' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
16' The free kick from long range, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' A cross from a corner kick by Nottingham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

14' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nottingham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
13' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
13' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
12' Brentford hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.

7' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.

5' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
5' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
3' 0 - 1 What an absolute cracking goal! Danilo (Nottingham) hits a perfect volley from long range and the ball flies into the bottom right corner. Take a bow son.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
Darren England got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
